title: Design a Basic Parking Lot
description: Model a parking lot with Vehicle enum, ParkingSpot types, and a Ticket system.

data.text: Design a parking lot that supports motorcycles, cars, and trucks. Each vehicle type fits in specific spot types. Issue tickets on entry, calculate fees on exit.
Use an enum for VehicleType, a ParkingSpot class with size constraints, a Ticket class linking vehicle to spot and time, and a ParkingLot class managing floors and spots.

data.title: VehicleType and ParkingSpot
Ticket and ParkingLot
Why this design?
data.text: VehicleType enum centralizes sizing rules. ParkingSpot validates fit itself, so ParkingLot does not need size logic scattered everywhere. Ticket tracks time and fee in one place.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Ticket is the single source of truth for billing
data.takeaway: A clean parking lot design separates concerns: spots know their size, tickets track time, and the lot manages availability.
